bullets.title: META: Muse traction drives stock re-rating but capex/equity-raise overhang weighs
bullets.body: META beat Q3 with revenue +26% YoY ($64.6B) and raised Q4 guide to $73-76B; Muse hit 10M+ US downloads with 25%+ daily retention and shopping as top use case. However, 2026 capex guided to $135-145B with management citing 'hundreds of billions' in future capital needs; company announced non-voting Class C shares effective Jan 2027 to enable equity raises without diluting Zuckerberg. CDS hit record 119bp; stock fell ~9% on the week despite the beat. Mizuho raises PT to $950 (OW); Piper trims to $850 on higher opex; Citi raises to $905 (Buy).

bullets.title: WDC: Monster beat and raise; HDD demand supply-constrained into 2031 with HAMR on track
bullets.body: WDC Sept quarter came in at $4.38B revenue (+5.8% vs consensus) with EPS $4.64 vs $4.11; Dec Q guided to $5.1B (vs $4.57B consensus) and GM 60-61% vs 57.8% consensus. Management noted demand visibility into CY30-31 across hyperscalers, neoclouds, AI labs, and frontier labs; ePMR ramp accelerating with HAMR qualification on track for Q1 2027, volume shipments H1 2027. 73% Buy, avg target $624 (82% upside). MS raises PT to $668 (OW); Citi cuts PT to $660 from $740 (Buy); Klein at Mizuho cuts to $490 from $590 (OW).

bullets.title: NFLX: Q3 in-line but Q4 miss; ad revenue cut to $2.7B from $3B; Wolfe downgrades
bullets.body: Netflix Q3 EPS $0.87 beat, but Q4 revenue guided $13.44B (vs $13.52B consensus) with op margin 26% and EPS $0.67 vs $0.73 consensus. FY26 ad revenue guidance cut from $3B to $2.7B due to slower ad product rollout; content chief Bela Bajaria and film chief Dan Lin both departed. Stock fell 6.6% on week. Wolfe downgrades to peer perform; Needham cuts to hold; MS keeps OW but cuts PT to $77 (from $80) on 17x FY28 EPS.

bullets.title: SPOT: Q3 mostly in-line; Q4 GM guide 33.8% better than feared; MS raises PT to $700
bullets.body: Spotify Q3 gross margin 33.0% beat guide, premium subs +6M vs +5M guide. Q4 OP income €820M vs Street €804M and gross margin guide 33.8% beat. Opex growth expected to moderate in Q4/2027 as AI spend normalizes. MS raises PT from $640 to $700 (OW) on ~30x FY28 FCF; Wells Fargo raises to $660 (23x FY28 EBITDA); KeyBanc raises to $690. Three analysts raised PTs; 72% Buy avg target $604.

bullets.title: CMCSA: Broadband losses worsening; Peacock profitable but parks soft; stays EW at MS
bullets.body: Comcast Q3 revenue $29.30B beat, adj. EBITDA $9.11B beat, FCF $4.21B well ahead, but broadband net losses -144K with Q4 seen at -218K on fiber competition. Parks EBITDA -17% YoY; Peacock +$261M EBITDA (from -$217M). NBCU spin on track for mid-2027. Morgan Stanley keeps EW at $27 PT; KeyBanc maintains Underweight at $18; Citi keeps Buy at $27.50. Wolfe keeps Peer Perform; notes cable EBITDA cut to $32.81B for 2026.

bullets.title: T: Beat on ARPU and fiber adds; raises EPS guide to $2.40; SpaceX wireless threat weighs
bullets.body: AT&T Q3 EPS $0.65 beat, EBITDA $12.51B beat; fiber net adds 442K ahead of guidance, postpaid phone adds 379K light; fiber ARPU -4.3% YoY. FY26 EPS guidance raised to ~$2.40 from $2.25-2.35; 2027-28 capex lowered to $22-23B. Stock fell 6-7% on SpaceX wireless entry threat (80K cell site talks). MS keeps OW but cuts PT to $25 (from $28); KeyBanc keeps OW at $36; Citi maintains Buy at $28 PT.

bullets.title: SpaceX wireless: Tower REITs surge 10%+ as SPCX negotiates 80K cell sites; telcos fall
bullets.body: SpaceX (SPCX) in talks with Crown Castle, American Tower, and Vertical Bridge for access to ~80,000 US cell sites using 800MHz spectrum acquired from Grain. CCI identified as prime beneficiary due to US-only exposure; leasing 80K sites could add $1-2B annual rent (+100-200bps domestic organic growth). Crown Castle up 8-9% on talks; AT&T and Verizon fell 4-7%. Citi and JPM both bullish towers: CCI Buy; analysts flag SpaceX terrestrial buildout as potential 4th national carrier.

bullets.title: AI-tech selloff: AI infrastructure basket down 12-16% MTD; de-grossing at multi-year extremes
bullets.body: SOX fell 6.7% in a single session (worst since June); NDX -2.9% on Thursday. Hedge fund L/S tech performance -9.6% MTD for TMT funds. GS Prime noted global Info Tech saw largest 2-week net selling on record (-3.3 std devs). AI infrastructure net exposure fell to near market-weight from 5% overweight. The selloff was driven by META capex language ('hundreds of billions'), LRCX soft guidance, and CRWV credit stress (2031 notes near 16% yield). $33B in levered ETF rebalancing on Thursday was 3rd largest single-day supply since 2010.

bullets.title: CRWV: Goldman upgrades to Buy ($106 PT); credit stress persists at 15-16% yields
bullets.body: Goldman upgraded CoreWeave to Buy (from Neutral) cutting PT to $106 from $139, citing contract value upside and sub-1-year payback IRR. However, CRWV unsecured bond spreads widened ~300bp since late August; MS cuts to Equal-weight at $70 PT noting CRWV needs $24-37B additional debt to reach 3.3GW capacity by YE27. CoreWeave 2031 notes yield near 16%. Stock down 30%+ past month; short thesis from multiple sources on debt sustainability and GPU depreciation.

bullets.title: TXN: Blowout beat on data center/industrial recovery; strong pricing power into 2027
bullets.body: Texas Instruments delivered Sept Q revenue $6.06B (+2% vs consensus), EPS $2.62 (+7.4% vs consensus), gross margin 64.2% vs 61.6% consensus. Dec Q guided well above seasonal with Industrial, Auto, and Data Center strength. Data center nearly doubled YoY; Industrial up 40% YoY hitting all-time peak. Management signaling capex will rise if growth sustains. Prior TXN GM peak was 69-70%; 2027 consensus GMs of 64% viewed as conservative given revenue trajectory. Stock down slightly AH despite strong report.

bullets.title: OMC: 7.2% organic growth crushes 3.4% consensus; FY guidance implies 4Q slowdown
bullets.body: Omnicom Q3 organic revenue +7.2% well ahead of consensus ~3.5%; won Coca-Cola North America, L'Oreal, CVS, Mercedes extended through 2029 and 2028 LA Olympics. Core EBITA margin expanded +200bp YoY to 18.2%; on track for $900M IPG synergies in 2026. FY26 guidance ~5% implies Q4 deceleration to ~3%. MS raises PT to $85 (EW), up from $83.

bullets.title: BE: Third consecutive beat and raise; MS raises PT to $335; AI power demand broadening
bullets.body: Bloom Energy Q3 beat consensus by 15% on revenues; raised 2026 guidance +11% revenue, +17% OI, +20% EPS for third straight quarter. Backlog growth exceeded revenue growth; capacity ramp to 5GW+ evidenced by $231M YTD capex (~4x FY25). Oracle Project Jupiter delivered 35% emissions reduction using BE fuel cells. MS raises PT to $335 (from $310, OW); Roth maintains Neutral at $230 (PT cut from $260 on sector multiple compression); Opco rates OW at $292.

bullets.title: CRM: Acquires Braze for $47.50/share ($5.66B EV) to strengthen marketing cloud
bullets.body: Salesforce announced definitive agreement to acquire Braze in all-cash deal, ~5x forward revenue and 40x FY28 FCF. Deal valued at 58% premium; expected to close FY28 (by Jan 2028). No change to FY27 guidance. JPM maintains Overweight; Wolfe keeps Outperform at $360 noting near-term headwinds but strategic upside. KeyBanc Sector Weight says deal solves Marketing Cloud gap. CRM stock fell ~3% on announcement.

bullets.title: INTC: Upgraded to Neutral at JPM from Underweight; $8-10 CY29/30 EPS power recognized
bullets.body: JPMorgan upgraded Intel to Neutral at $85 PT (unchanged), citing improving foundry visibility from Arizona Fab 62 and Ohio projects as demand strengthens. Wolfe Research notes $8-10 EPS power in CY29-30 but flags execution risk vs. alternatives. Stock up 4.6% on upgrade day. No change to short-term fundamental view; upgrade reflects reduced downside risk at current valuation.

bullets.title: MU: Citi Buy on $35B buyback and 3D DRAM roadmap; Taiwan strike risk averted
bullets.body: Micron announced $35B share repurchase increase (largest in company history) and 3D DRAM technology roadmap. Taichung union labor agreement signed, substantially reducing strike risk. Company abandoning 4F² DRAM development on complexity/cost grounds. Citi maintains Buy. Next product milestones: 1-delta DRAM node in H2 2027, Gen 11 NAND in H2 2027 targeting 2x bit density vs Gen 9.

bullets.title: NOW: JPM bullish into print; 3Q cRPO expected 200bps beat with guidance acceleration
bullets.body: ServiceNow Q3 earnings due Wednesday Oct 28; JPM maintains Overweight at $150 PT, citing partner checks pointing to ~20% Elite partner business expansion and AI ACV on track to exceed $1.5B. Expect ~200bps cRPO beat with low-20% reported growth. Federal revenue seasonally strong in Q3; consumption monetization expected material driver in 2027. KeyBanc maintains Underweight at $85 PT on slowing bookings.

bullets.title: ORCL: Analyst Day 10/28 expected to raise FY30 targets; OCI backlog enables upward revisions
bullets.body: Oracle AI World and Analyst Day on 10/28; JPM expects FY30 revenue target raised from $225B with $12B+ upside, and FY27 guidance raised to at least $90B (from $85B). Citi similarly bullish, raising OCI/EPS estimates modestly ahead of event. Oracle CDS at widest level on AI debt concerns, but management expected to highlight partner financing reducing net capex pressure. Mizuho hosts dinner with Deloitte's Oracle leader to discuss OCI momentum.

bullets.title: AMZN: MS elevates to Top Pick at $350; AWS sold out past 2028; 30% upside to Hedgeye
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley raised AMZN PT to $350 (from $335) and added as Top Pick, modeling AWS growth acceleration to +47% in FY27 targeting $164.5B 2028 EBIT. CEO Jassy told a16z podcast AWS capacity largely committed through 2028; supply constraints expected to persist years. AWS custom chips (Graviton/Trainium) offer 30-40% better price-performance vs comparable. Hedgeye upgraded AMZN to top idea long with 30% upside over 12-15 months, citing AWS acceleration to 41% in Q4 vs Street 37%.

bullets.title: MSFT: Azure expected to accelerate to +46-47%; Maia 300 entering multi-GW deployment in 2027
bullets.body: Microsoft Q1 FY27 results due Wednesday Oct 28 (same day as FOMC). Buy-side expects Azure +47% YoY (vs guide high-end +44-55%), M365 Commercial Cloud +18% YoY. MSFT custom silicon Maia 300 entering production deployment in 2027 at multi-GW scale; FY27 capex expected above $220B. Partner checks and field checks described as strong. MS maintains OW; Hedgeye in bullish trend (MSFT one of only 4 of 36 AI names remaining bullish).

bullets.title: SHOP: 3Q GMV tracking ~32-33% vs Street 30.3%; Oppenheimer raises to $205
bullets.body: Third-party data shows Shopify GMV growth tracking 2-3 points above Street consensus for Q3. Oppenheimer raises SHOP from OW $175 to $205 on profitability confidence. Platinum partner checks show AI traffic currently 2-3% of GMV, could reach 10%+ in 1-2 years. Sidekick analytics usage high among tenured merchants; Shop Pay moat and enterprise adoption accelerating. AI agentic commerce (Muse, Google Universal Cart) seen as long-term structural tailwind for SHOP platform.
